rules:
The first line contains a single integer $$$n$$$ ($$$1 \leq n \leq 10^5$$$) — the number of rectangles.

Each of the next $$$n$$$ lines contains two integers $$$w_i$$$ and $$$h_i$$$ ($$$1 \leq w_i, h_i \leq 10^9$$$) — the width and the height of the $$$i$$$-th rectangle. Unique token result under retained description; generated qualification and independent oracle/audit outstanding.
